notes.title: Halloween Update Is Here!!!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Happy Halloween in the coming days, to celebrate I have made a small update all Halloween themed. This update adds some temporary changes and some extra objects to the game. Hop into the game to see them yourself before they're gone! [Game will go back to normal on the 4th of November]

notes.title: Update V1.09
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
I know it has been a while since the last update, that's due to me being unsure on things to add and the stuttering issue really took me this long to figure out a way to fix/work around.(There will still be small stutter when enemies spawn in due to the nature of this work around but that will reduce the stutter from 100% of the time to around 10% of the time and I am continuing to work on this issue)
There will still be more updates in the future as well as I still plan on fixing/adding/changing a bunch of things. 

Anyway, here are the update notes for this small update (V1.09)

- Have changed the moss/grass texture that is on top of rocks
- Have moved and re-scaled a few environmental objects around the start area
- Have added a new construction zone at start of game carpark area
- Have changed the shadow settings for low quality setting to show more shadow details
- Have extended terrain lod to help with terrain fragments appearing too close to camera
- Minor bug fixes(a few collider issue glitches)
- Have done a work around to reduce the stuttering. (Please let me know how it is on your system.)

Thank you all so much, I hope you all enjoy this update! :)

notes.title: Important Update Information
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

I wanted to let you all know that I am still working on The Forgotten and am working on getting an update finished. It may be a little longer until the new update as I am trying to fix majority of the issues. For a start the main thing I’m trying to make work better is enemy and animal AI systems (specifically enemy) to try and make them feel more alive and meaningful. 

I am also working on some performance improvements and just overall issue fixes and making systems a bit more polished. I’m a one man team working on this so it may take a bit for the next update but it will be a good update that should alleviate many of the issues and problems! 
I look forward to seeing what you all think when the new update is published!

Thank you all for being honest in reviews and patient so far! :)

notes.title: Update V1.08
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
I have another update for you all here, this one is mainly focused on adding some extra sounds/a few sound scares etc. The patch notes are below!

Added In Update
- Added a faint heartbeat sound when enemies are near the player
- Have changed some foliage LODs to remove shadows when they're not needed to help with performance
- Added a gasp sound effect when player finds some bodies
- Added a fly effect and sound to some dead bodies 
- Added some extra sounds around the map
- Have tweaked the deer ai a bit to make them better
- Have mildly tweaked some of the enemies damage stats, attraction stats & reaction stats 
- Extra fog added into main area

Thank you all so much, I will be doing more updates for this game but they will be slow to come out! :)

notes.title: Next Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Wanted to let you all know that the next update [V 1.08] will be coming out within the week. The update will add extra sounds, some scares, things to make the game a bit scarier, fixes and a bunch more!
I really hope you will all enjoy the update when it is released! :)

notes.title: Update V1.07
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
Todays update is a bit isn't a massive update but does fix a few things that I noticed were problems. I will try and fix the stutter in a future update but so far haven't had any luck in being able to fix it.
Here are the patch notes:

- Have fixed 'E' getting stuck on screen after picking up key in the town
- Have edited some environmental lods to make them not pop in as intense
- Fixed a few objects that were clipping through other objects
- Have altered texture quality for lower settings
- Have altered lod distance for Low quality preset
- Other small bug fixes

Thank you all!

notes.title: New Update Soon
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

I just wanted to let you all know that a new update will be coming out within the next few days or so!
Since the last update I have just taken a bit of a break to relax as I had been working on this game non stop for over a year! I will be getting back into doing some updates and fixing/adding anything else that needs to be done soon! :)

Thank you!

notes.title: Update Version 1.06
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
Todays update is very important as it FINALLY fixes the issue the game was having with the achievements!! Here are the patch notes:

- Have added an icon on the map for the keycard spawn location 
- Have added a table in small cave area to have better placement for key spawn chance
- Fixed issue where "Objective Updated" would appear even after you already triggered it
- Fixed issue where a certain object had 2 Es next to it when picking it up
- Fixed Achievements not working
- Various other small bug fixes

Thank you all so much, I hope you're happy now that you can finally get all the achievements!! :)

notes.title: Update Version 1.05
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, 
This update adds 2 new major features to help with everyones navigation and just overall make the game better! Keep in mind that these 2 new features will be added upon within the next few updates; Here are the update notes.

- Have fixed 2 bits of text not translating
- Have updated keyboard layout
- Have added a basic map to help with navigation [Press M to use, for now the map only shows the main area]
- Have added a simple objective system [More objectives will be added in coming updates]

Thank you! :)

notes.title: V 1.05 Big Update Soon
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

I just wanted to let you all know that V 1.05 is going to be a really big update with additions and quality of life improvements! The update should be coming out tomorrow or the day after [11th-12th ADCT].
Without saying exactly what is in the update I can say that the contents of it will help a lot with not getting lost in the game and helping with guidance as to where to go and when!

Thank you all so much! :)

notes.title: Update Version 1.04
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Todays update is a bit smaller due to trying to figure out some other issues but we hope you enjoy this update anyway :)

- Removed a few small objects that were getting in the way
- Added candles around a few key items to help players find them
- Changed texture of a few key items to have a slight glow
- Fixed a few bits of text not being translated properly
- Added text that appears when a key is needed for a door
- Changed keyboard control layout

Thank you!

notes.title: Small update
notes.notes:
Hello,

I just posted through a small update, there wasn't enough for it to worthy of a version change as I was just fixing one bug today while I still investigate the achievement issues! 
But for those that are interested, I fixed a bug where one of the scripts that teleport you wasn't working so that is now fixed 

Thank you, I have some plans for the coming updates that I hope will improve the game and allow everyone to enjoy it :)

notes.title: Game Update V 1.03
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
Here are the contents of the update today. Keep in mind not everything has been fixed and in future updates this will be changed to be better [achievements are still a problem but will be fixed soon]

- Fixed loading screen from credits to main menu
- Altered a few names in the credits
- Fixed issue where shard wouldn't allow you to use meteorite
- Added a new flashlight icon that indicates the charge of the flashlight
- Replaced a few old variations of the health bottle with newer ones [no longer stuck in key items inventory]
- Fixed some lights not having volumetric light
- Added a world fog for more ambience
- Added description text to the inventory explaining what it is used for
- Boxes no longer have button press icon, they can be moved by player walking into them
- Have edited secret areas objects to be lower poly to help with the lag
- Change the med health bottles so you can't use them if your health is too high
- Fixed issue where barn had no navigation mesh
- Fixed an issues where one of the ending weren't working properly
- Various small fixes and additions

Thank you all so much, I hope you enjoy this new update! :)

notes.title: Update Version 1.02
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Here are the patch notes for V 1.02. I hoped to get more fixed in this version but spent too much time trying to fix achievements which are still not working.
Also I am working on improving the enemy AI fully.

- Removed left over objects that are not supposed to be in final build
- Have made the deer react a bit better to the player (not fully done yet)
- Enemy AI should now notice player better (the ones sitting down for the most part)
- Fixed one of the combo notes not being able to be used
- Removed some of the enemies
- Friends at start now have backpacks
- Removed various items around map that were not needed
- Other various fixes
- Have altered some of the UI to make it be clicked easier and to help with issues

Thank you all, I will continue to fix and make this game better for you all :)

notes.title: Version 1.02 will be out tomorrow
notes.notes:
Hello,

Just wanted to let you all know that V 1.02 will be out tomorrow, have had to push it over to tomorrow as the update will fix quite a lot and so is going to take a bit longer to work on!

Thanks :)

notes.title: Update Version 1.01
notes.notes:
Here are all the fixes for update Version 1.01 [please not I am aware of many other issues and will fix them in future updates]

V1.01 

- Fixed bag at starting camp playing audio when pressed
- Added an E when you pick notes up to better help people understand
- Have altered nav mesh near house doors to stop enemies from blocking you in the houses
- Fixed invisible door 
- Fixed door prompt appearing when not needed
- Fixed a few floating objects
- Fixed barn not having colliders
- Added quite music in background 
- Fixed note not being able to be read in cave & town
- Fixed some of the lag from the fires
- Fixed some of the lag from a secret area

Thank you all so much, more updates will be coming out soon!

notes.title: Todays Release Schedule
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

After far too many issues and plenty of release date push backs I am happy to tell you when The Forgotten and extras will be releasing today.[If there are any changes I will do another post to let you know]
SCHEDULE:

1:30PM ACDT: Replace screenshots with new ones + 3 new never seen screenshots

5PM ACDT: Short release trailer; and The Forgotten game released

I am excited to release this game finally, I have been working on this game by myself for a long time now so I am really excited to see what everyone thinks! And remember, if you find bugs you can post them in the bug report section. 
Thank you all so much!

notes.title: Language Issues Release
notes.notes:
Hello,

Just a bit of an update on the issues the game is having with the languages. So there's good and bad news, the bad news is that I have to re-do around 40% of the games dialogue/texts to make the languages be able to work which means I am having to push the release to March 3rd to allow time to actually re do it all.
The good news though is that I am able to fix the language issues which I am so happy about, as I don't want to have the game in only English! 
Thank you all for sticking through all of this, but please understand I really haven't wanted to push the release date back at all but for the game to be how I want it and for the game to have other languages it has to be done. :)

notes.title: 4 Days Until Release!
notes.notes:
Hello all!

We're so close to release now! I'm hard at work fixing the last few bugs that have been found for release day and now waiting until the day arrives so I can click 'release'

I want to thank you all so much for being patient and I am very excited to see what you will all think! :)

notes.title: 2 Weeks Until Release!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

There are only 2 more weeks until you can all play The Forgotten! 
We are excited to see what you will all think when you're able to play it, and we are excited to finally click that release button. 

Thank you all for waiting for the game to be released, it has been a long road but we are happy to be on the last stretch! :)

notes.title: Final Release Date Set!!
notes.notes:
Hello,
We would like to start this by saying thank you all for being so patient with us and out multiple set backs! :) 
We have found what the issue was we were having and am currently in the process of fixing it, once we have done that we just need steam to approve it then we will be ready for release on the 24th of February! and the reason for waiting until then is so that we can do last testing to make sure everything is how we want it and to allow steam enough time to approve.
Be prepared for a scary, fun and thrilling experience

notes.title: Release Date!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

After a very long time and a few push backs I am happy to announce that The Forgotten will be releasing in December of this year! An exact day will be published soon but due to issues with steam and in development I can't say an exact date right now. Even so the game will be coming out in December and will be before Christmas! 
Thank you all for staying around while I was hard at work developing The Forgotten everyday! :)

notes.title: Trailer Release
notes.notes:
Hello,

I've been trying to upload the trailer for just under 2 hours so far and it isn't working for some reason on steam, so for the meantime while I try and figure that out you can watch the trailer on youtube! I'll do another post when I can get it to post onto steam!

notes.title: Trailer Release Reminder
notes.notes:
Hello all,

Just a reminder that our first long overdue trailer for The Forgotten will be releasing on the 15th. The exact time of the release will be around 1pm ACDT [5:30am PT]
I hope you will all really enjoy the trailer.

Disclaimer: Everything you see in the trailer is subject to change and a few minor things have been changed just for the purposes of recording the trailer.
Thanks! :)

notes.title: Trailer Release Date
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We will be releasing our first LONG over due trailer on the 15th of this month to show you all what the game looks like. There will be more trailers after this one as well, this is first of many. 
Thank you everyone for being really patient with me and the development time, as a solo dev I have been coming up against many issues with the game, but I can assure you that it is being worked on everyday as much as I possibly can.

Thank you SO MUCH!!

notes.title: Release Date Info & GIVEAWAY
notes.notes:
Hello,

Our release window of Q2 will need to be pushed back a little to early Q3. The reason behind this are the problems we spoke about in the last dev log are persisting and we have had another issue where after saving if you load back into the game the player will automatically die. We are sorry to have to push the release back but we believe that it is better to take more time on the game and make sure it is polished than release the game now with multiple issues present!

Thank you all for being so patient and we will be releasing our first trailer within the week!! 
We would also like to reward everyone here for being so patient so if you would like to win a free copy of The Forgotten* please comment below anything*1 and we will use a bot to fairly choose who wins. There will be 3 winners



* You will be able to activate key before release but game is locked until release
*1 Offensive comments etc will disqualify you

notes.title: Game Release Date Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone.

We know the creation of this game has taken a long time, we've had some set backs and would have like to have had it already released but we were unable to. But now we are happy to say that our release window for The Forgotten is late Q2 2020 [End of June].
The reason behind this release window is the game is basically completed but need that extra time to add in last minute things, a few change of plans things, testing and just to make sure the game actually runs well. Again we are sorry for it taking a long while but we are sure you will enjoy it when released!

Regards, Ragdoll Inc

notes.title: Trailer Release Date
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We are happy to announce that our trailer for The Forgotten will be being released here and on YouTube on the 15th of March!! We are excited to see what you will all think about the game once you see the trailer.

We would also like to thank you all for your patience while we are working on finishing The Forgotten, it is taking us longer than we thought to finish but we are trying to make it as good as possible and have as little issues as possible.

Regards,
Ragdoll Inc
